"'
O vient
" (
transl.
Oh wind
) is a song by Italian rapper
Clementino
. It was released on 3 May 2013 by
Universal Music Italia
as the first single from the third studio album
Mea culpa
.
[
1
]
Music video
The
music video
, directed Calu, was released in conjunction with the song's release on Clementino's
YouTube
channel. It was filmed at the City of Science in
Naples
, in the part reduced to rubble by a fire on the night between 3 and 4 March 2013.
